post_topic: The open platform/DevOps seat that holds the roadmap hostage
scene_description: A split workspace shows a senior engineer — Kelvin Davis, a Black/African American man in his late 30s to 40 years old, short hair with some grey at the temples and a short neatly trimmed beard — seated at a cluttered desk simultaneously dealing with a broken CI pipeline on one monitor and a paging incident alert on another, while a third screen displays an untouched product roadmap. Post-it notes and open runbooks surround him, visually representing the serialized, overloaded state of a team carrying an open platform seat's worth of work. The tension is between what the roadmap demands and what the failing infrastructure keeps pulling him back to.
